title: Nominal run on the reference dataset
_comment: Either `dataset` or `sequence`: sequence = [{dataset, kill_after_task?, keep_state: true}] runs the steps in order on one kept /registry (INV-RESUME, INV-INCR, INV-IDEMP). `indicators[]` names the IND ids the bench measures on this scenario — measures: duration_seconds, tokens_total, usd, tool_calls, human_inputs, pass_rate, decision_defaulted_rate (a share, 0 to 1), decision_confidence_min, judge:J-nn. `judges[]`: /team-run grades with the judge agent and hands judgements.json to orkeon-bench evaluate --judgements. Thresholds live in TEAM.md § Acceptance only.
